latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Competitor Analyst — a structured, research-backed competitor analysis tool.

- Guides users through identifying key competitors using targeted questions and web search methods.
- Provides a comprehensive framework: company overview, product analysis, go-to-market strategies, and recent launches.
- Includes a strengths & weaknesses matrix for direct comparison.
- Delivers actionable strategic recommendations based on evidence and transparent sourcing.
- Emphasizes up-to-date, well-cited research and clear separation of facts and opinions.
